thread:
Elaine (PM): Quick sync — need to finalize sprint matrix + customer signoffs for the enterprise compliance launch this sprint. Key asks: searchable audit logs, BYOK handshake, SOC2 evidence bundle, retention tiers. Who can run tradeoffs?
Matt (Eng): I can. rough priorities: 1) audit logging schema + export, 2) BYOK handshake (initial MVP), 3) retention policy enforcement. SOC2 evidence is more ops/playbook than infra.
Priya (Security): Agree. Two security constraints: (a) BYOK keys must never leave customer KMS; we need a handshake spec + attestation; (b) audit logs must have tamper-evident integrity metadata.
Sam (Customer Success): Customer A (regulated fintech) gave firm date: end of next month for BYOK + 1yr retention SLA. They'll sign off if we provide a rollout plan + test harness.
Elaine (PM): Ok — we need concrete launch criteria for each ask so Sales can get yes/no. Propose:
- Audit logs: searchable index + export to S3 + proof-of-integrity (sha256 chain)
- BYOK: handshake flow doc + automated key-rotation test + concierge onboarding checklist
- SOC2 evidence: packaged evidence set + runbook for evidence export (not necessarily automated in M1)
- Retention: policy tiers (30/365/730 days) with customer-selectable SLA and export on-delete option
Can we convert to a sprint matrix?
Matt (Eng): I'll draft a matrix. Quick notes: searchable index (ELK/managed) has cost/latency tradeoffs — full queryable logs for all customers will increase storage by ~3x. We can implement sampling + hot index for last 90 days to keep costs bounded.
Priya (Security): Sampling is okay if we offer a compliance tier with full indexing for paying customers. Must be explicit in contracts. Also need cryptographic proof for exports: sign each log batch with a rotating service key, store signature chain.
Ravi (Legal): If we offer different indexing levels, contracts must state what data is retained and what counts as "audit evidence." Also add a clause about customer-requested retention extensions and legal hold.
Sam (Customer Success): For Customer A we should offer full-indexing in Dedicated plan + concierge onboarding. They want BYOK handshake tests: we need a deterministic test harness they can run.
Matt (Eng): Draft of sprint matrix (quick):
```
- M1 (this sprint): audit-log schema, basic export to S3, BYOK handshake spec doc, evidence runbook draft
- M2: integrity signing chain, retention tiers, automated export-on-delete
- M3: full searchable index (hot 90d), concierge onboarding flow, SOC2 evidence automation
```
Elaine (PM): Good. Now launch criteria per item (suggested, plz thumbs up):
- Audit export ready: export test passing + sample retention policy applied on staging :thumbsup:
- BYOK handshake: successful key import/export sim + security attestation signed by Priya :eyes:
- SOC2 evidence: legal-approved evidence list + runbook walkthrough with customer success
- Retention tiers: policy enforcement test matrix + billing flag toggles working
Priya (Security): I will sign attestation once BYOK handshake has: HSM-backed key reference, zero-copy key exchange, and automated proof-of-ownership flow. I need design doc link.
Elaine (PM): Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/byok-handshake-draft (working doc). Matt, can you populate the sequence diagram by EOD?
Matt (Eng): Yes, will drop sequence diag + a minimal conformance test (GH#4021).
Sam (Customer Success): I'll pre-send the runbook + acceptance criteria to Customer A this week. If they confirm, we can use their signoff as launch gating for BYOK early access.
Ravi (Legal): Also adding a legal-hold requirement — when a customer flags a legal-hold, retention clock pauses and export-on-delete is disabled until release. Need a short clause in the MSLA.
Elaine (PM): Noted. Final question: do we treat SOC2 evidence automation as MVP-blocker or post-launch?
Priya (Security): Post-launch. As long as we provide a reproducible evidence bundle and runbook, SOC2 automation can be follow-on.
Matt (Eng): OK. I'll attach cost estimates in the matrix (storage + index cost delta).
ops-bot: deploy-checklist: audit-export tests passed on staging -> 4/5, BYOK sim tests pending -> 1/3
Elaine (PM): Action items:
- Matt: sprint matrix + sequence diag + cost delta (owner) — due Thu
- Priya: BYOK attestation checklist + security constraints doc — due Thu
- Sam: customer acceptance criteria email to Customer A + gather signoff — due Fri
- Ravi: legal clause draft for MSLA + legal-hold wording — due Fri
- Ops (automated): finish BYOK sim tests -> escalate if failing
Please react with :thumbsup: if you agree to owners/dates or propose changes.
Matt (Eng): :thumbsup:
Priya (Security): :thumbsup:
Sam (Customer Success): :thumbsup: will ping Customer A now
Ravi (Legal): :thumbsup:
Elaine (PM): Thanks — I'll consolidate into the kickoff doc and link back when matrix is posted.
